_comment: Planner coverage floors, in percent. OWNER POLICY 2026-11-10: unit tests are retired — the unit floor is 0 (measured for information only, it can never block). 100% UI test coverage is enforced by code. A project may override its own in profile['coverage'] {unit_floor, ui_floor} — that is a project fact and belongs in the project. Code-enforced in team/research.py (_validate): when the UI leg is below 100%, the plan's queue HEAD must be the executable entry that raises UI coverage (its 'target' names src/androidTest/** or src/test/** and friends), unless a delivery fire (red CI or a store rejection) outranks it.
